name: lokey
description: Local-only encrypted key/value vault: a desktop app for Windows

scripts.check: biome check --write . && tsc --noEmit && npm run test:ui && vite build && cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check:ci: biome ci . && tsc --noEmit && npm run test:ui && vite build && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
